purpose: Check fixture ID alignment for the four 90-row GW001 league competition keys
sql: SELECT r.competition_key, COUNT(*) AS results_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN m.sm_fixture_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matched_fixture_ids, SUM(CASE WHEN m.sm_fixture_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS results_without_report, SUM(CASE WHEN m.sm_fixture_id IS NOT NULL AND m.competition_key=r.competition_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_key, SUM(CASE WHEN m.sm_fixture_id IS NOT NULL AND m.competition_key<>r.competition_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS different_key FROM `GW001_IMC Results` r LEFT JOIN `GW001_IMC Match Report` m ON m.sm_fixture_id=r.sm_fixture_id WHERE r.competition_key IN ('GW001|CUS|DOMESTIC|league|1','GW001|CUS|DOMESTIC|league|2','GW001|CUS|DOMESTIC|league|3','GW001|CUS|DOMESTIC|league|4') GROUP BY r.competition_key ORDER BY r.competition_key
